note: From docs, developer reports and device tests.

platforms.note: Autoplays the MP4 muted, looping. With autoplay off or Reduce Motion: poster with a play button. Apple's guidelines: the page itself under 1 MB; icon, image and video together under 10 MB. A video that can only be streamed (HLS) needs a tap. Device-tested 24 Oct 2026. Without og:image: a text bubble with the title, the domain and the site icon (seen 24 Oct 2026).

Inline player with a play button; does not autoplay. Device-tested 24 Oct 2026 on the Mac and iOS clients with a plain og:type website page and a direct MP4. Discord's docs only describe og:type video.* or twitter:card player; neither was needed. Without any og: or twitter: tags: no embed at all, just the link (device-tested 24 Oct 2026, Mac and iOS, on a page with only a <title> and meta description). Discord's docs: MP4, WebM or MOV; the fetch returns at most 50 MB and must finish, measuring the image and video included, within 10 seconds.
platforms.refresh: Caches previews for about 30 minutes; until then, resharing the same URL shows the old card. Share it with a new query string such as ?v=2, or look it up in the Embed Debugger (discord.com/developers/embeds).

platforms.note: Shows og:image. Tested 24 Oct; FxEmbed's claim that it plays did not hold.

Link cards show og:image. The viral og:video posts were iMessage screen recordings. The large card needs twitter:card=summary_large_image; otherwise a small card with a square thumbnail. Without og:image: the small card with a placeholder; without any og: or twitter: tags: no card. On the large card X overlays the title in a dark strip at the bottom-left of the image and puts the domain under the card as 'From domain' (measured on x.com at desktop and 390 px phone widths, 24 Oct 2026).
Uses og:image as the thumbnail; og:video not mentioned.
Classic unfurls read Open Graph and Twitter Card tags and show og:image; video players only for sites Slack handles itself, or through an app unfurl.
Link cards carry a title, description and one thumbnail (app.bsky.embed.external); there is no video field.
platforms.refresh: The card is saved into each post when it's written, so a post keeps its card; a new post fetches the page again.

platforms.note: Video cards come from oEmbed, not og:video.
Shows og:image with the title and description; no video.
Reads og:image, title, description; no video seen.
Element shows the title, description and og:image that the homeserver's URL preview endpoint returns; no og:video support.
Shows og:image. Tested 24 Oct; docs say an MP4 is only 'eligible' for inline play. Without og:image: a text card with the domain and title (Sharing Debugger, 24 Oct 2026).
platforms.refresh: Paste the URL into the Sharing Debugger (developers.facebook.com/tools/debug); it scrapes the page again. Images are cached by URL and don't update unless the image URL changes.

refresh.tip: Apps cache a preview by its URL, so after you fix the tags an app can keep showing the old card. Share the link with a new query string, such as ?v=2, and give a changed og:image or og:video file a new URL too.
